class.name: GameplayTag
class.brief_description: A single hierarchical tag, owned and handed out by [GameplayTagsManager].
class.description: Tags are dotted names forming a hierarchy: [code]A.B.C[/code] matches the parent query [code]A.B[/code], but not [code]A.B.C.D[/code]. Do not author these inline in a resource or construct them by hand. There is exactly one canonical instance per name, owned by the manager; any other instance compares equal by name but is not the same object. Ask for one with [method GameplayTagsManager.request_tag].
